name: Koš (Slovakia)
description: Divided per saltire into blue at the hoist and fly and white at the top and bottom, with a yellow saltire, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature K-61/1995.
